source: Bank of Japan, Flow of Funds Accounts: flat file fof2_en.zip (current accounts) and the BOJ Time-Series Data Search API (1968 SNA accounts, discontinued)
note: Sectors nest: all holders, the Bank's groups and the sectors under them are all listed, so adding every row counts money more than once; the ownership book picks the finest sectors that add up. The older accounts value holdings differently and are never added to the current ones: financial institutions' and governments' holdings are at book value (they change only by what was bought in almost every quarter, even through the 1990 crash), companies' and individuals' shares at market value, foreign investors' on a mix, and shares issued at book value; their government bonds and bills list no holdings by companies or foreign investors. Amounts are billions of yen.
